messages:
ana: quick heads up, quant rollout in eu1 is showing p95 regressions for short prompts, detected 03:12 UTC.
reza: any 5xxs or just latency?
ana: latency only, p95 up ~900ms vs baseline ~240ms. attaching trace shortly.
ken: can we hotfix with a config revert? what's minimal change?
ana: yes, swap kernel selector for seq<=64 back to legacy path. built image: registry.redwood/inference/eu1:hotfix-quant-b2
opsbot: [dry-run] registry.redwood/inference/eu1:hotfix-quant-b2 validated in staging, smoke ok.
ana: propose flow: dry-run -> 10% canary 8m -> evaluate -> manual hold -> ramp 50% -> final 100%. auto-rollback if predict.latency.p95 > 400ms.
reza: +1 from oncall, add tag rollback:quant-b2-2026-03-21 and notify #incidents.
ken: +1 from release, require manual hold before full.
mara: support asks for expedited window, aiming to resolve within 30m.
ana: issuing deploy now. command: /deploy start --cluster eu1 --image registry.redwood/inference/eu1:hotfix-quant-b2 --canary 10% --canary-window 8m --auto-rollback-metric "predict.latency.p95" --rollback-threshold 400
opsbot: [deploy] canary 10% started in eu1.
opsbot: [metric] predict.latency.p95 baseline=240ms current=275ms
reza: monitoring traces, tokenizer CPU back down for canary.
opsbot: [canary] 10% success. holding for manual approval.
ken: manual approved, proceed to 50%.
opsbot: [deploy] scaling canary -> 50%
opsbot: [metric] predict.latency.p95 now=290ms
mara: customers' alerts cleared. Ops on standby.
opsbot: [deploy] rolling to 100% in eu1
opsbot: [metric] predict.latency.p95 now=300ms
ken: documenting: "hotfix revert: kernel selector for short sequences; eu1 rolled 100% 2026-03-21; rollback tag rollback:quant-b2-2026-03-21"
ana: added to release notes and closing. thanks all. :tada:
